_readme: What the picture chain has learned from reviews, as rules for ANY brand, product, avatar or ad (the owner, 2026-10-27: "all of these notes must be agnostic feedback ... if we can get any level of automation out of this, feedback needs to be rolled up into the chain and agnostic so the next run is even better"). A note from a review becomes one row here, in the same change that makes the chain obey it: `said` is the note word for word with where it came from, `rule` is it written for every ad, `enforced_by` is where the chain applies it (`file :: a line of that file`, checked by test_preview.py). Never a note kept for one ad. Every row is `draft` until the owner approves it; a rule he strikes becomes `deprecated` with its code removed in the same change.
